integrity: References distinguish inspected full texts from abstract-only material. General mathematical tools credited. The self-review is not independent confirmation.
scientific_limitations: Exact discrete rank-one border-collision map with integer parameter \(m\ge2\); no claim for nonlinear Filippov flows or nearby non-integer parameters. General Markov-symbolic and piecewise-affine density theorems can recover components. Priority search is nonexhaustive; Gora 2009 was available as abstract only. The universal theorem is analytical, finite checker supplementary.
title: Renewal entropies and incompatible typical statistics in a grazing-sliding border-collision family
